meta.title: Game Facts #5: GTA 6: 17% spike in time off requests
meta.alt_title: GTA 6 PC rumored 2027 as consoles drive leave spike
meta.summary: A new report shows a 17% spike in time off requests for GTA 6's console launch on 19 November, while a PC version is rumored for early 2027. Rockstar's marketing includes a $975,000 neon sign and an NBA game rebranded as Vice City Heat.
meta.comment: Will you take time off for GTA 6?
sources: IGN, GTA 6 Causes 17% Spike in Time Off Requests on Game's Release Date, 2026-10-26
Polygon, GTA 6 sets PC release date, new report says, 2026-10-13
facts: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
GTA 6's release has led to as much as a 17% increase in time off requests, according to a new report.
A PC port is rumored for early 2027.
Rockstar spent $975,000 to install a massive neon pink sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena.
An NBA game between the Miami Heat and the Milwaukee Bucks on November 18 will turn the Heat into the Vice City Heat.
Rockstar has not officially commented on its potential plans to bring GTA 6 to PC.

es.title: Datos de GTA 6 #5
es.summary: Un informe revela un aumento del 17 por ciento en solicitudes de vacaciones por el lanzamiento de GTA 6 en consolas el 19 de noviembre, y se rumorea una versión para PC a principios de 2027. El marketing de Rockstar incluye un letrero de neón de 975.000 dólares y un partido de la NBA renombrado como Vice City Heat.

pt.title: Fatos de GTA 6 #5
pt.summary: Um novo relatório mostra um aumento de 17 por cento em pedidos de folga para o lançamento de GTA 6 nos consoles em 19 de novembro, com uma versão para PC prevista para o início de 2027. O marketing da Rockstar inclui um letreiro de neon de 975.000 dólares e um jogo da NBA renomeado como Vice City Heat.

hi.title: GTA 6 के तथ्य #5
hi.summary: एक नई रिपोर्ट से पता चलता है कि 19 नवंबर को GTA 6 के कंसोल लॉन्च के लिए छुट्टी के आवेदनों में 17 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई है, जबकि शुरुआती 2027 में पीसी वर्शन की अफवाह है। रॉकस्टार की मार्केटिंग में 975,000 डॉलर का नियॉन साइन और वाइस सिटी हीट के रूप में रीब्रैंड किया गया एनबीए गेम शामिल है।
